messages:
mira: Heads-up from crit: compact timeline clusters are confusing in dense histories. Users want a clear affordance to expand a cluster and see the individual snapshots without losing context. Fig: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/cluster-expand (internal). Thoughts?
jon: Love the expand-in-place idea. Proposal: cluster shows a small count (+8) and a caret. On click it morphs into a horizontal mini-strip of the contained snapshots with keyboard focus preserved. Escape collapses back.
sasha: Accessibility: clusters must be operable via keyboard and announced properly. Use a single composite button role with aria-expanded and aria-controls, and when expanded expose the contained items as a list with aria-activedescendant. Also announce "Expanded cluster, 8 snapshots" via aria-live="polite".
a11y-bot: A11y checklist: ensure the cluster button has a descriptive label (e.g., "Expand 8 snapshots from Mar 23"), create keyboard traps avoidance so focus can move out, and provide a visual focus ring that meets contrast ratios. For users relying on screen readers provide a list view fallback in settings.
jon: Visual detail: when expanded the mini-strip should show pattern overlays for canary weights but reduce density (thinner hatches) so it stays legible. Add a lightweight hover tooltip showing timestamp + short commit message.
mira: Microinteraction: animate size change with a gentle scale/opacity but respect prefers-reduced-motion. Also, when expanding, dim the rest of the timeline slightly to draw attention, but ensure dimming doesn't drop contrast below 3:1 for any interactive bits.
sasha: Keyboard nav idea: when cluster is focused press Enter to expand, then use J/K or Left/Right to move within snapshots. Press 'v' to open a quick version diff peek, 'r' to open rollback modal. Document these in keyboard help.
qa-bot: qa-bot: note: tests should verify cluster expand/collapse via keyboard, ARIA announcements, and that tooltips appear on focus as well as hover (ts=1977777805).
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: cluster-expanded user=jon cluster=1977777733 count=8 ts=1977777810
mira: Copy tweak: change 'Preview rollback' buttons inside clusters to 'Review changes (no live impact)' so it doesn't look like a destructive action. For cluster-level rollbacks add explicit confirmation listing affected services.
jon: Action items: I'll prototype the in-place mini-strip + hover tooltips. Sasha please draft the ARIA attributes and keyboard mapping. Mira will write the copy variations and accessibility fallback options. QA to add test cases. We'll review in crit next Tue. Thanks!
